set.body:
Outcome

Prevent further investment in the architectural surface being replaced.

Acceptance

- No new RoiPayload, Response, FeatureSetKind, FoldPlan, RoiAnalysis, or MvpaResult cases are permitted.
- A checked list names all legacy symbols, modules, examples, and documentation to remove.
- Completion requires zero production, test, example, and current-doc hits, except an explicitly historical migration note.
- Temporary bridges must be package-private, branch-local, and deletion-tracked.
set.title: P0.4: freeze the legacy ontology and define the zero-cruft completion court
